data.rationale: The proposal gets the core sequence right (open the city's special events, click the event, select ticket count, click Book Now, click Reserve Now), but it omits city selection and the date, and it lists "event" and "time slot" as parameters instead of date, so an automation would be somewhat vague on navigation and on which event to pick.
